review: Full-Stop Heathcliff (FS Heathcliff) is the winner of the 5th Walpurgisnacht Event, dishing out great damage by himself constantly. He is unique among the Ammo archetype, as when he runs out of Ammo, he retreats from combat, similar to Devyat Identities. When he returns, he will reload and recover all his Ammo, except for his Special Ammo. This makes it so that running out of Ammo during a particularly long fight isn’t as bad as a consequence. FS Heathcliff starts with 10 Ammo, which forces you to play around when you spend that Ammo to get full use out of FS Heathcliff before he retreats. Luckily enough, if you activate his Passive and just use his Defensive Skills to preserve Ammo, he will gain 10 Poise Potency, Haste, 1 Pierce Power Up, and apply 3 Poise Potency to an ally, with additional Poise Potency coming from the Evade maxing out at 9.
